facts.fact: The Ministry of Home Affairs itself takes applications, prints and distributes national identity documents, printing 166,237 between 1 April 2025 and 30 June 2026, per its spokesperson.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Home Affairs printed 166,237 national identity documents between 1 April 2025 and 30 June 2026, of which 125,999 were collected.
